documents.title: Product launch example
documents.text:
# Product launch example

This fictional workspace demonstrates a small product launch with two epics. Example completion represents a fictional decision, not acceptance of real work.

## Product foundation

Agree on scope, build a prototype, persist settings, and check keyboard access.

## Delivery

Write the guide, gather pilot feedback, address findings, and publish. Dependencies keep release work behind the relevant checks.

The separate pilot-expansion proposal remains a draft until you approve its exact revision. Loading examples does not start agents, configure a repository, or approve that proposal.
